notes.title: Planet Pioneers release
notes.notes:
After more than 1 year in development, you now finally receive Planet Pioneers as full release 🥳

To keep things transparent, here are some details if you are still unsure if it’s worth the price.

[b]What are the main changes compared to the demo?[/b]
[olist]
[*] Planet size progression (Planets become bigger and more difficult over time)
[*] You can turn off pollution if you want
[*] Free build mode (including configurable planet generation)
[*] Desert and ice planets
[*] Multiple new tiles, including a few tiles with wider range
[*] Updated tutorial setup
[*] Saving the progress (only allowing one savegame at a time)
[*] Steam achievements and highscores
[*] Some balancing
[*] A lot of bugfixes (obviously) and quality of life changes
[/olist]

[b]What might be included in a future version (NOT promised):[/b]

[olist]
[*] Full controller / Steamdeck support (so far the feedback in tests was that the placement with controller is too tedious)
[*] More variance for common buildings
[*] Dedicated Linux build
[/olist]


If you have any feedback / questions, feel free to post them here or in the community hub!

notes.title: Demo v0.1.1 - Biomes and ocean
notes.notes:
Thanks for everyone giving feedback on the demo so far!
This update is a first step to improve the demo and add more details to the game.

[b]General changes[/b]
+ added polar and desert biome to the earth planet type
+ rotation now follows the planet axis to keep camera orientation
+ increased difficulty
- removed full desert and full ice planet

[b]Buildings / Tiles[/b]
+ added fish (randomly generated on the planet)
+ added fishing boat
+ added palms
+ added oasis

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- new packages button only works when packages are available
- fixed bug showing a tutorial part too early
